prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Miniature Beasts illustration for a botanical-tome page in the game's Library. Flat artwork filling a 1:1 canvas, painted with clean light from the upper left, soft shadows, crisp edges, no noise. No creature, no person, no text, no letters, no logos.
A PRESSED-SPECIMEN PLATE from a botanical tome, second attempt for a lantern clan: an aged cream paper page with a deckled edge; at each of the four corners of the page a single small engraved lantern with a soft marigold glow and a sprig of hatching, in deep umber ink; along the very top and bottom edges of the page a thin single engraved rule with a tiny lantern at its centre; a faint warm glow in one outer corner. The centre of the page, two thirds of it, stays bare cream paper with no frame around it. Colours: cream paper, umber ink, a hint of marigold and lagoon teal. Quiet, exact, a herbarium feel.
TEXT: none at all; no letters, numerals or words anywhere.
Constraints: the centre of the canvas is a perfectly empty, flat, unmarked square of cream paper covering about 66 percent of the width and height; nothing is drawn inside it and nothing rectangular is drawn around it: NO inner frame line, NO border of small shapes around the square; the only decoration sits at the four corners of the page and along the page's outer edge, far from the square. Nothing looks like a QR code, a barcode or a grid.
preamble: No reference images: the motif is described in the prompt.

result.disposition: kept as alternative (the same scheme on an open book page; decodes with the default search)
